Next.js Public Marketing Site · Complete Design System · Copy Architecture · SEO · Conversion Flow

Phase 1 is complete. Torgima is a working individual execution system. Before users can find it, there must be a public presence — a marketing website that communicates what Torgima is, why it is different, and how to get access. This prompt builds the complete marketing website as a separate section of the existing Next.js app, deployed to the same domain. The marketing site shares the codebase but has its own layout, design language, and conversion goals.
torgima.com/dashboard → Operational execution language. Dense intelligence. Condition badges. Signal bars. For paying users who are executing inside the system.
torgima.com (homepage + marketing pages) → Benefit language. Social proof. Clear value proposition. Conversion-optimized. For potential users who have never heard of Torgima.
